title: Day 134: Container Ship GFS Galaxy Struck in Strait of Hormuz — 1 Indian Crew Member Killed
detail: Container ship GFS Galaxy was struck by a projectile while transiting the Strait of Hormuz. One Indian crew member was killed; a second was initially reported missing and later recovered on July 14.

media.caption: 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis — GFS Galaxy struck July 11
